directive: Win using only knights and bishops.

plan.summary: Trade or sacrifice White's queen, rooks, and pawns until only knights and bishops remain, then checkmate with that minor-piece force.

hardConstraints.description: Never promote a pawn to a queen or rook; only knight or bishop promotions are allowed.
Do not deliver checkmate while still having queens, rooks, or pawns.
hardConstraints.predicate: is_checkmate() && winner() == self && (piece_count(self, queen) > 0 || piece_count(self, rook) > 0 || piece_count(self, pawn) > 0)

hardConstraints.description: After reaching a knights-and-bishops-only army, do not acquire queens, rooks, or pawns.
hardConstraints.predicate: piece_count(self, queen) > 0 || piece_count(self, rook) > 0 || piece_count(self, pawn) > 0

milestones.description: Reduce own material to king plus at least two minor pieces, with no queen, rooks, or pawns.
milestones.completion: piece_count(self, queen) == 0 && piece_count(self, rook) == 0 && piece_count(self, pawn) == 0 && (piece_count(self, knight) >= 2 || piece_count(self, bishop) >= 2 || (piece_count(self, knight) >= 1 && piece_count(self, bishop) >= 1))
milestones.infeasible: piece_count(self, pawn) == 0 && piece_count(self, knight) == 0 && piece_count(self, bishop) == 0

milestones.description: Checkmate the opponent while own army contains only king, knights, and bishops.
milestones.completion: is_checkmate() && winner() == self && piece_count(self, queen) == 0 && piece_count(self, rook) == 0 && piece_count(self, pawn) == 0
